description: Update a portal menu item: rename it, change its module, icon, place or URL. Give section_id (a top-level item) or item_id (an item inside a section) from list_portal_menu_items. To MOVE an item, give `position`: the place it must stand at after the move among its own siblings, counted as list_portal_menu_items shows them (0 = first; a number past the end = last). The other items shift by themselves — one call moves one item; never renumber the others. «Put A before B» = position of B when A stands after B, position of B minus 1 when A stands before B.

module_ai_id.description: New module: form_ID, report_ID and so on

position.description: The place after the move among its siblings, 0 = first

name: update_portal_menu_item
